plugins.name: callum-flow
plugins.description: Issue-orchestrator and implement-issue skills for running a GitHub ready-issue queue end to end.

plugins.name: factory-hud
plugins.description: Opt-in mod: a status entry with the time, context fill, plan usage, factory counts and tool versions on every surface, including mobile and desktop through Remote Control.

plugins.name: factory-loop
plugins.description: The issue orchestrator as a deterministic loop: claims, gates and merges a repo's ready issues in code and wakes Claude only for judgment calls. For orchestrator workspaces (the orchestrator-loop Coder template); not enabled by default.

plugins.name: factory-loop-workspace
plugins.description: The factory loop's companion, enabled beside factory-loop: starts each agent the loop runs in its worktree slot, confines its writes and pushes, gives its commands a 10-minute timeout, and holds a writer's finish while the repo's gates fail.
